patch_description: Replace the CZ chain in the fourth block with an XX chain while keeping all RY and RZ operations intact. This tests whether mixing entanglement types (CZ in blocks 1-3, XX in block 4) captures complementary correlations while maintaining the highly efficient 2-parameter structure. Prior Program 1 demonstrated that mixed entanglers can achieve perfect accuracy; this variant applies that insight surgically to the deepest/final block only, which may benefit most from alternative correlation patterns.
